title: JANUS Cross-Registry Branching Reanalysis 02 — L10-L13 Expansion and Four-Phase Reproducibility Gate
purpose: Расширить cross-registry модель L0-L9 новыми слоями L10-L13 и исполнить воспроизводимый четырёхфазный reanalysis, строго разделяя физические факты, статистические результаты, научные интерпретации, структурные аналогии и открытые гипотезы.

epistemic_labels.FACT: Наблюдаемое/документированное утверждение, подтверждённое подходящим источником или воспроизводимым измерением.
epistemic_labels.INTERPRETATION: Физическая/математическая модель, используемая для объяснения фактов, но не являющаяся отдельным наблюдаемым объектом.
epistemic_labels.ANALOGY: Структурное сходство между двумя слоями без утверждения тождества механизма.
epistemic_labels.OPEN_HYPOTHESIS: Проверяемое утверждение, для которого требуются дополнительные данные или эксперимент.

L10_simulation_branching.label: Симуляционная среда как branching-машина
content: save/load создаёт наблюдаемые альтернативные состояния игрового мира
corrupted saves и CTD рассматриваются только как software-state failure analogues
L10_simulation_branching.hard_boundary: Ни save/load, ни modding, ни CTD не являются физической декогеренцией.

L11_memory_identity.label: Когнитивная психология памяти и идентичности
content: автобиографическая память строится как жизненная нарративная система
детско-родительское reminiscing связано с развитием детализации автобиографической памяти
ложные детские воспоминания возможны, но их частота и полнота ограничены и зависят от метода
различаются autobiographical belief, recollective experience и memory confidence
external_anchors: Fivush 2011 review on autobiographical memory development
Wu & Jobson 2019 meta-analysis on maternal reminiscing
Brewin & Andrews 2017 systematic review of false childhood memories
Howe 2019 review of early autobiographical memory/childhood amnesia
L11_memory_identity.hard_boundary: Психологические результаты не диагностируют персонажей или игроков Fallout и не доказывают fictional memory mechanisms.

L12_emulation.label: Эмуляция как экспериментальный полигон
content: agent/cellular/state-machine simulations for event -> record -> observer pipelines
synthetic pseudo-event nulls to measure false correlations
parameter sweeps to identify sampling/exposure regimes that create spurious nuclear-UAP associations
L12_emulation.hard_boundary: Эмуляция проверяет свойства моделей и артефактов выборки; она не симулирует реальную физику Вселенной автоматически.

L13_atomic_cultural_discourse.label: Историко-культурный атомный дискурс
content: atomic splitting as cultural metaphor for creation/destruction
postwar science-fiction and religious reinterpretations of nuclear power
Children of Atom as a fictionalized atomic cosmology
HAWKAR_INDIVISIBLE_CHILDREN historical atomic lineage as a separate source artifact
L13_atomic_cultural_discourse.hard_boundary: Культурная повторяемость мотива не является физическим доказательством cosmological branching.

requirements: Freeze exact source versions, commit refs, publication versions and available byte hashes.
Where raw-byte SHA-256 is unavailable, record Git blob SHA plus explicit SHA_STATUS=NOT_COMPUTED rather than inventing a byte hash.
Freeze analysis code and dependency versions.
Use Docker or equivalent reproducible environment when practical.
Recover the exact dataset/code used by the original Palomar result before attempting any correction.
Reproduce original result without changing preprocessing.
Reproduce independent 2026 replications before pooled synthesis.
phase_0_freeze_and_reproducibility.admission: All requested reproductions must either numerically match within preregistered tolerance or have a documented, source-backed reason for deviation.

phase_1_controlled_nuclear_uap_test.unit_of_analysis: observation opportunity/day-site or event-rate unit appropriate to each dataset
models: Poisson or negative-binomial event-rate model with exposure offset
logistic model for binary event occurrence when justified
hierarchical/partial-pooling model for site-specific variation when justified
phase_1_controlled_nuclear_uap_test.primary_gate: Effect must survive preregistered exposure normalization and matched controls; otherwise nuclear-association claim is not admitted.
phase_1_controlled_nuclear_uap_test.interpretive_ceiling: Any surviving association remains an association, not proof of UAP causation, extraterrestrial agency, observer effects or branching universes.

bear_gnome_skeleton: Extract all effective REFR placements and winning overrides.
Compute teddy/skeleton, teddy/gnome and gnome/skeleton enrichment with same-cell controls.
Run 128 and 512 unit thresholds plus geometry/vertical sensitivity.
Compare tragedy, child-room, store and ordinary-domestic contexts using pre-frozen exact location labels.
Exclude overt joke/diorama scenes as a robustness sensitivity analysis.
james_memory: Trace exact James pod identity: Vault112PodTermDad -> MQ04DadPodShellRef -> TLpod01/MQ04PodDad role-aware candidates.
Trace MQ04 INFO Begin/End embedded scripts, Conditions and SCRO links.
Search Braun privileged control plane for source-specific persistence/serialization/transfer edges.
Search carrier/storage/alias/session handles without assuming a literal WRITE opcode.
Reject ReferencedBy as causal direction until executable semantics are established.

psychology_bridge.testable_question: Do the game's motifs of childhood, memory and identity map structurally onto known properties of autobiographical memory without implying clinical diagnosis?
controls: distinguish belief from recollective experience and confidence
separate game narrative mechanics from human memory experiments
do not use psychology literature as evidence for in-game technology

candidate_crossings.label: ANALOGY
candidate_crossings.statement: Save/load and mod branches instantiate alternative game states, structurally analogous to branching but not physical decoherence.

candidate_crossings.label: ANALOGY
candidate_crossings.statement: Psychological distinctions among autobiographical belief, recollection and confidence provide an external conceptual vocabulary for analyzing James/memory narratives, not proof of Vault 112 technology.

candidate_crossings.label: TEST
candidate_crossings.statement: Synthetic observation schedules and pseudo-events can test how easily sampling/exposure alone generates a false nuclear-UAP association.

candidate_crossings.label: ANALOGY
candidate_crossings.statement: Fallout's atomic cosmology participates in a broader cultural pattern of treating nuclear division as world-making/destruction.

candidate_crossings.label: OPEN_HYPOTHESIS
candidate_crossings.statement: If an independently validated nuclear-UAP residual association survives all controls, an Everettian interpretation may be discussed as one ontology, but the empirical association would still not detect another branch directly.

candidate_crossings.label: ANALOGY
candidate_crossings.statement: Atomic world-making metaphors and game save/mod branching both turn division into multiplicity, but in different ontological domains.

forbidden_upgrades: UAP correlation -> proof of parallel universes
memory-themed game mechanics -> evidence for human memory mechanisms
spatial object clustering -> hidden in-world placer without causal edge

phase_gating.rule: A phase cannot upgrade the epistemic label of a later phase until its own admission conditions are met.
phase_gating.crossing_rule: Cross-layer synthesis may cite a lower-evidence layer, but cannot promote it to the highest-evidence label of the stronger layer.

source_integrity_notes.nuclear_uap_registry: Existing registry contains preregistered layers and historical posteriors; historical posteriors remain versioned results, not automatically current conclusions.
source_integrity_notes.palomar_research: Current literature is contested: an independent 2026 replication reports the core association, while a separate 2026 critical evaluation argues that observation scheduling and plate/data issues can remove significance. Both must be reproduced rather than cherry-picked.
source_integrity_notes.many_worlds: Current 2026 Stanford Encyclopedia revision describes worlds/branching and decoherence; this is an interpretational framework, not a direct detector of separate classical universes.
source_integrity_notes.memory_psychology: Modern research distinguishes autobiographical belief, recollective experience and confidence; false childhood memories can occur under suggestion, but susceptibility and full-memory formation are limited and method-dependent.
